name: elrobot-record
description: Record ElRobot teleoperation demonstrations (7-joint + gripper leader and follower arms, arm and table cameras) as a LeRobot 0.6.1 dataset on the device, and optionally upload it to the Hugging Face Hub.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port for the recorder's web page (status, countdown, camera pictures, and the next, re-record and stop buttons; also the calibration page): open http://<device>:<port> in a browser

variables.name: FOLLOWER_SERIAL_DEVICE
variables.description: USB serial tty of the ElRobot follower arm (12 V, the arm that copies your moves). ttyACM1 on the team's Jetson; check with ls -l /dev/serial/by-id/ on the device. It must be connected when you deploy.

variables.name: LEADER_SERIAL_DEVICE
variables.description: USB serial tty of the ElRobot leader arm (5 to 7.4 V, the arm you move by hand). ttyACM0 on the team's Jetson. It must be connected when you deploy.

variables.name: CALIBRATION_VOLUME
variables.description: Persistent volume that holds the arms' LeRobot calibration files (follower.json, leader.json); elrobot-policy mounts the same volume
